title: Parametric constraints, associative drafting, reusable symbols/blocks and deterministic patterns
objective: Complete the bounded CAD/BIM product boundary defined by the Architecture v1.1 roadmap by adding deterministic parametric constraints, associative drafting, reusable 2D symbols/blocks, and deterministic mirror/array/pattern operations without changing frozen architecture or existing canonical boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Representative constrained drafting workflows execute deterministically through the governed typed App API.
Supported associative annotations and symbol relationships refresh deterministically from canonical source elements and report typed dangling/reference-loss outcomes without silent re-targeting.
Reusable 2D symbol/block definitions and instances persist through save/open/replay with exact document-owned canonical identities and lineage.
Mirror, rectangular/polar array and bounded pattern operations produce stable deterministic ordering and canonical identities and support exact undo/redo/replay.
Web and Electron execute the same semantic command/query stream and converge to equivalent persisted results and canonical content hashes.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..018 and compatibility/BIM/IFC baselines remain green and pinned fixtures remain byte-identical except for explicitly declared additive migrations.
Renderer/application code remains free of native engine and host-specific imports and all native operations remain behind existing adapter/worker boundaries.
Constraint, association, block and pattern capabilities outside the bounded vocabulary return explicit typed deterministic failures and never fabricate semantics.
The new workflows are exercised through the real Web UI; Electron uses the same shared semantic host surface and receives parity evidence where applicable.
The exact final implementation head receives terminal CI evidence plus exact deployment/browser evidence where applicable and all governance evidence is revision-bound.
No protected architecture artifact changes; any necessary architecture change is routed through the ACR/version process.
non_goals: Full AutoCAD, Archicad or Revit feature parity.
Arbitrary dynamic-block programming or unrestricted block scripting.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-018 is VERIFIED on main at merge 3edd5506d972dc309b22c21baad7643f021f27d4 and is the immediate specialized-toolset predecessor.
COMPAT-CAD-003 is VERIFIED and provides the existing documentation/associative annotation foundation.
COMPAT-BIM-003 is VERIFIED and provides the canonical BIM information/component baseline.
Construction Graph remains authoritative and CADDocument remains the editor working representation.
ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout the work item.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic constraint grammar, validation and bounded solve/update tests with explicit typed unsupported outcomes.
Associative drafting tests covering source mutation, refresh determinism, dangling/reference-loss behavior and no silent re-targeting.
Reusable symbol/block definition and instance tests covering canonical identity, persistence, replay and exact undo/redo.
Mirror/array/pattern tests covering stable deterministic ordering, transforms, identities, persistence and reversibility.
Web/Electron semantic parity fixtures over representative workflows.
Pinned fixture and repeat-run byte-identity evidence.
Regression evidence that CAD-PARITY-002..018 and compatibility/BIM/IFC baselines remain green and byte-identical where required.
Real browser evidence for the new Web workflow and Electron evidence where a new Electron-only surface exists.
Exact-head CI verification and deployment/browser evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, CI, deployment, merge and post-merge verification.
